task1.title: How instant noodles are manufactured
task1.prompt: The diagram below shows how instant noodles are manufactured.

chartDesc.title: Manufacturing instant noodles

stages.label: Storage silos
stages.detail: Flour delivered by truck is stored in silos and then moved to a mixer

stages.label: Mixer
stages.detail: Flour from storage silos is combined with water and oil in a mixer

stages.label: Dough sheets
stages.detail: The mixture is pressed by rollers to form dough sheets

stages.label: Dough strips
stages.detail: The dough sheets are cut into dough strips

stages.label: Noodles discs
stages.detail: Dough strips are shaped into circular noodle discs

stages.label: Cooking (oil) + drying
stages.detail: Noodle discs are cooked in oil and dried

stages.label: Vegetables + spices
stages.detail: Dried noodle discs are put into cups along with vegetables and spices

stages.label: Labelling + sealing
stages.detail: The cups are labelled and sealed for final packaging

chartDesc.overview: The linear manufacturing process consists of 8 main stages, beginning with raw ingredients (flour, water, and oil) and concluding with packaged, sealed noodle cups.
keyFeatures: Linear 8-stage sequence without loops or repeating cycles
Inputs added at different stages: flour, water, and oil at the start; vegetables and spices added into cups near the end
Transition from raw dough preparation (sheets, strips, discs) to cooking/drying and final cup packaging

task1.instruction: Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

task2.title: Advertising and whether people still pay attention to it
task2.prompt:
Some people say that advertising is extremely successful at persuading us to buy things. Other people think that advertising is so common that we no longer pay attention to it.

Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.
task2.instruction: Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
